description: This source file implements a transformation pass that converts array return values in functions to out parameters, modifying function prototypes, call sites, and return statements accordingly. It is part of a shader compiler or translator, specifically within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: ArrayReturnValueToOutParameterTraverser
classes.description: A traverser class that modifies function prototypes, call sites, and return statements to convert array return values into out parameters.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method that applies the transformation to the AST root node.

methods.name: createReplacementCall
methods.description: Creates a new function call node with the out parameter appended.

methods.name: visitFunctionDefinition
methods.description: Handles function definitions, setting context for functions with array return values.

methods.name: visitFunctionPrototype
methods.description: Replaces function prototypes with array return types to void and adds an out parameter.

methods.name: visitAggregate
methods.description: Handles call expressions, replacing calls that return arrays with out parameters.

methods.name: visitBranch
methods.description: Replaces return statements in functions with array return values to assign to out parameters.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Replaces assignments of array return values with calls that assign to out parameters.
